source_caption_data.pre_caption: This is an underwater scenery shot depicting a serene and sunlit ocean floor. Large, rounded boulders, partially covered in green moss and shelf-like coral, frame the view, while beams of sunlight pierce the deep blue water from above, illuminating a vibrant patch of bright green seagrass on the seabed below. There is no main subject because the shot is designed to establish the environment and create a sense of atmosphere. The focus is on the scale and natural beauty of the underwater landscape rather than any single entity. The few small, distant fish are included to add life and depth to the scene, not to serve as a focal point.
